key_insight: Volumetric PTV with Shake-The-Box can resolve the Imperial Front Wing wake in enough detail to validate high-fidelity Nektar++ LES and reveal a previously unreported vortex structure.
engineering_relevance: This provides a benchmark dataset and a practical validation route for motorsport aerodynamics, supporting more reliable CFD use for complex unsteady industrial flows.
method: Volumetric Particle Tracking Velocimetry (PTV) in the 10x5 Imperial College wind tunnel
Shake-The-Box reconstruction of the wake downstream of the open-source Imperial Front Wing at Re=74896
Comparison against implicit LES in Nektar++ and prior planar PIV results
evidence_signal: The abstract reports good quantitative agreement in wake topology between volumetric PTV and LES, including identification of a new vortex that prevents merging of dominant structures.
watch_item: PTV/STB remains experimentally demanding in industrial settings, so calibration, particle seeding quality, and volume coverage can strongly affect reliability.
paper_title: Flow behind the Imperial Front Wing: comparison of results from volumetric PTV experiment and Nektar++ simulations
